issue.title: Implement Sync of Selected Take Changes
issue.body:
Changing which take is selected for a verse or passage on mobile does not currently count as a change that needs to sync, so the new selection stays on the device and never reaches the server. This ticket makes a selected take change sync back to the server like any other local change.

## Functional Requirements

### Change Detection
- Treat a change to the selected take as a pending change that needs to sync.
- Mark the change as pending whether the selection is made online or offline.
- Mark the change as pending when the selection moves from one take to another, including a take recorded by a different account on the device.

### Sync Behavior
- Send the pending selected take change to the server on the next sync.
- Include the selected take change in the same sync that uploads the chapter's other pending changes.
- Sync a selected take change even when no new audio has been recorded since the last sync.
- Clear the pending state once the server confirms the change.
- Keep the change pending and retry on the next sync if the sync fails.

### Server State
- Make the server's selected take match the device after a successful sync.
- When the selection changes more than once before syncing, send only the latest selection.

Note: Replaces the earlier behavior in #279, where a canonical designation did not trigger a sync on its own and was sent only when the owning account synced.
